_README: Copy to /usr/local/etc/fleet_alarm.json on bsd and tune. Thresholds are ACTUAL battery mV; see fleet_alarm.md. Devices NOT listed under low_vcc.devices are never battery-checked (mains devices IrrCntrl/PowerMonitor whose last column is not vcc). caliper reports no vcc column. Email uses bsd's already-configured mailer (sendmail -> ssmtp); this daemon holds no SMTP credentials.
